let chatIdx = 0;
const MAX_H = 340;
const chatHistory = document.getElementById('chatHistory');
const chatBadge = document.getElementById('chatBadge');
const chatTitle = document.getElementById('chatTitle');
const chatMeta = document.getElementById('chatMeta');
const chatCount = document.getElementById('chatCount');
const chatExpand = document.getElementById('chatExpand');

function el(tag, cls, text) {
  const n = document.createElement(tag);
  if (cls) n.className = cls;
  if (text != null) n.textContent = text;
  return n;
}

function renderChat() {
  const c = CONVERSATIONS[chatIdx];
  chatCount.textContent = (chatIdx + 1) + ' / ' + CONVERSATIONS.length;
  chatBadge.textContent = c.kind === 'illustrative' ? 'ILLUSTRATIVE' : (c.correct ? 'OK' : 'MISS');
  chatBadge.className = 'chat-badge ' + (c.kind === 'illustrative' ? 'chat-badge-illu' : (c.correct ? 'chat-badge-ok' : 'chat-badge-miss'));
  chatTitle.textContent = c.title;
  chatMeta.textContent = (c.prompt_version || '') + (c.model ? '  ·  ' + c.model : '');
  chatHistory.innerHTML = '';
  chatHistory.scrollTop = 0;
  chatExpand.textContent = 'Expand full response';

  c.turns.forEach(function (t) {
    const row = el('div', 'msg msg-' + t.who);
    const bubble = el('div', 'msg-bubble');
    if (t.image) {
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = t.image;
      img.alt = 'document image';
      img.className = 'msg-img';
      bubble.appendChild(img);
    }
    const body = el('div', 'msg-text');
    const pre = document.createElement('pre');
    pre.className = 'msg-pre';
    pre.textContent = t.text;
    body.appendChild(pre);
    bubble.appendChild(body);
    row.appendChild(bubble);
    chatHistory.appendChild(row);
  });

  const preList = chatHistory.querySelectorAll('.msg-pre');
  if (preList.length) {
    const last = preList[preList.length - 1];
    if (last.scrollHeight > MAX_H) {
      last.classList.add('collapsed');
      chatExpand.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      chatExpand.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
}

let expanded = false;
chatExpand.addEventListener('click', function () {
  expanded = !expanded;
  const preList = chatHistory.querySelectorAll('.msg-pre');
  preList.forEach(function (p) {
    if (expanded) p.classList.remove('collapsed');
    else p.classList.add('collapsed');
  });
  chatExpand.textContent = expanded ? 'Collapse response' : 'Expand full response';
});

document.getElementById('chatPrev').addEventListener('click', function () {
  chatIdx = (chatIdx - 1 + CONVERSATIONS.length) % CONVERSATIONS.length;
  expanded = false;
  renderChat();
});
document.getElementById('chatNext').addEventListener('click', function () {
  chatIdx = (chatIdx + 1) % CONVERSATIONS.length;
  expanded = false;
  renderChat();
});
renderChat();
</script>
:::

## Illustrative threads

The three threads below are **hand-written** examples of the cascade the prompt is designed to produce — they
are not logged model output. They show the intended reasoning for the three hardest discriminations:
`invoice` vs `budget`, `memo` vs `letter`, and `form` vs `handwritten` when handwriting appears inside a
printed form. Step to them in the player above (they are tagged *Illustrative*), or read them here.

::: {=html}
<div class="illus-threads">
  <div class="illus-card"><h3 class="illus-title">Invoice vs. Budget — payment demand decides</h3><p class="illus-meta">v17.2 rules &middot; qwen/qwen3.7-flash (illustrative)</p><div class="illus-msg">A page of charges with a total at the bottom.</div><pre class="msg-pre">pre-scan: no mail-client header, no masthead, no memo block.
Check 1 file_folder: no — the page is a printed table, not a folder label.
Check 2 handwritten: no.
Check 3 letter: no — no salutation or closing.
Check 4 memo: no — no MEMORANDUM header.
The discriminating question from the prompt: is there a *payment demand* — an amount due to be paid, with vendor and billing terms?
The table lists line items with a grand total and &#x27;AMOUNT DUE&#x27; — that is a demand for payment.
The prompt explicitly routes financial/money-data tables with a payment demand to invoice (&#x27;a bill is a bill even when it is printed on a form&#x27;).
Check 5 budget: no — budget is a plan of expenditures, not a demand for payment.
&lt;/scratchpad&gt;
&lt;label&gt;invoice&lt;/label&gt;</pre></div>
  <div class="illus-card"><h3 class="illus-title">Memo vs. Letter — the closing line settles it</h3><p class="illus-meta">v17.2 rules &middot; qwen/qwen3.7-flash (illustrative)</p><div class="illus-msg">A short typed page that opens 'Dear Dr. Barnes' and closes 'Sincerely'.</div><pre class="msg-pre">pre-scan: no masthead, no memo header.
Check 3 letter: yes — a formal salutation (&#x27;Dear Dr. Barnes&#x27;) followed by body text and a closing (&#x27;Sincerely&#x27;) with a signature block.
Memos are the reverse: a MEMORANDUM header with TO/FROM/DATE/RE lines, no salutation, no closing signature. This page has none of those markers.
The salutation + closing are strong, concrete, readable evidence, so I commit at Check 3.
&lt;/scratchpad&gt;
&lt;label&gt;letter&lt;/label&gt;</pre></div>
  <div class="illus-card"><h3 class="illus-title">Form beats subject matter — a data page can still be a form</h3><p class="illus-meta">v17.2 rules &middot; qwen/qwen3.7-flash (illustrative)</p><div class="illus-msg">A page of technical values filled in by hand.</div><pre class="msg-pre">pre-scan: the page has printed labeled fields (&#x27;NAME:&#x27;, &#x27;ACCOUNT NO:&#x27;, &#x27;DATE:&#x27;) with values entered in the blanks — a structured form.
Check 2 handwritten: there IS handwriting, but the handwriting is *inside* a printed form structure, not a freehand note. The prompt&#x27;s rule: classify by dominant function — the form fields control the page, so the handwriting does not win the check.
Check 1 file_folder: no. Check 3 letter: no. Check 4 memo: no.
The labeled-field skeleton with blanks is the strongest concrete evidence on the page.
&lt;/scratchpad&gt;
&lt;label&gt;form&lt;/label&gt;</pre></div>
</div>
:::

<script>
(function () {
  var status = document.getElementById('ab-count');
  var base = (window.location.pathname.match(/.*\//) || ['/'])[0];
  fetch(base + 'data/model-ab.json')
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) { init(data); })
    .catch(function (err) {
      var el = document.querySelector('.ab-widget');
      if (el && status) el.querySelector('.ab-toolbar').insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',
        '<div style="padding:12px 14px;color:#b03030;">Could not load A/B data (' + err.message + ').</div>');
    });

  var state = { filter: 'all', flipsOnly: false, idx: 0, laneA: 0, laneB: 1, diff: false };

  function filtered(images) {
    var out = images.filter(function (im) {
      if (state.filter !== 'all' && im.axis !== state.filter) return false;
      if (state.flipsOnly && !hasFlip(im)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    return out;
  }

  function hasFlip(im) {
    var ok = im.runs.some(function (r) { return r.correct; });
    var miss = im.runs.some(function (r) { return !r.correct; });
    return ok && miss;
  }

  function shortModel(m) { return m.split('/').pop(); }

  function runLabel(r, i, total) {
    var m = r.model_short || shortModel(r.model);
    return (r.prompt ? m + ' \u00b7 ' + r.prompt : m) + ' \u2014 ' + (r.predicted || '(no label)') + (r.correct ? ' \u2713' : ' \u2717');
  }

  function init(data) {
    var images = data.images;
    var widgetEl = document.querySelector('.ab-widget');
    var imgEl = document.getElementById('ab-img');
    var fnEl = document.getElementById('ab-filename');
    var expEl = document.getElementById('ab-expected');
    var axisEl = document.getElementById('ab-axis');
    var laneASel = document.getElementById('ab-laneA');
    var laneBSel = document.getElementById('ab-laneB');
    var laneAEl = widgetEl.querySelector('[data-lane="A"]');
    var laneBEl = widgetEl.querySelector('[data-lane="B"]');
    var diffChk = document.getElementById('ab-diff');
    var swapBtn = document.getElementById('ab-swap');
    var hintEl = document.getElementById('ab-hint');

    function current() {
      var list = filtered(images);
      if (!list.length) return null;
      return list[Math.min(state.idx, list.length - 1)];
    }

    function render() {
      var list = filtered(images);
      if (state.idx >= list.length) state.idx = list.length - 1;
      if (state.idx < 0) state.idx = 0;
      var n = list.length;
      document.getElementById('ab-count').textContent = n ? (state.idx + 1) + ' / ' + n : '0 / 0';
      if (!n) {
        hintEl.textContent = 'No images match the current filters.';
        return;
      }
      var im = list[state.idx];
      expEl.textContent = 'expected: ' + im.expected;
      axisEl.textContent = im.axis === 'cross_model' ? 'cross-model \u00b7 four models on the shared 160-image slice at v11.8' : 'prompt evolution \u00b7 qwen3.7-flash, same image';
      if (im.image) { imgEl.src = im.image; imgEl.style.display = ''; } else { imgEl.style.display = 'none'; }
      fnEl.textContent = im.filename;

      // lane dropdowns
      var opts = im.runs.map(function (r, i) { return '<option value="' + i + '">' + runLabel(r, i, im.runs.length) + '</option>'; }).join('');
      laneASel.innerHTML = opts;
      laneBSel.innerHTML = opts;
      if (state.laneA >= im.runs.length) state.laneA = 0;
      if (state.laneB >= im.runs.length || state.laneB === state.laneA) state.laneB = state.laneA === 0 ? 1 : 0;
      laneASel.value = state.laneA;
      laneBSel.value = state.laneB;

      renderLane(laneAEl, im.runs[state.laneA], im.expected);
      renderLane(laneBEl, im.runs[state.laneB], im.expected);
      if (state.diff) applyDiff(laneAEl, laneBEl);
      renderVerdict(im);
      hintEl.textContent = 'pick an image, choose any two runs \u2014 same document, different reasoning';
    }

    function pill(r, expected) {
      if (r.no_label) return '<span class="ab-pill ab-pill-nl">NO LABEL</span>';
      return r.correct
        ? '<span class="ab-pill ab-pill-ok">OK</span>'
        : '<span class="ab-pill ab-pill-miss">MISS</span>';
    }

    function renderLane(laneEl, r, expected) {
      var model = laneEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-model');
      var prompt = laneEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-prompt');
      var verdict = laneEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-verdict');
      var meta = laneEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-meta');
      var pre = laneEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-reason');
      model.textContent = r.model_short || shortModel(r.model);
      prompt.textContent = r.prompt || '';
      var pred = r.predicted ? r.predicted : '(no parseable label)';
      verdict.innerHTML = pill(r, expected) + ' ' + pred + (r.predicted && r.predicted !== expected ? ' \u2192 ' + expected + '? no \u2014 expected ' + expected : '');
      var bits = ['predicted: <b>' + pred + '</b>', 'expected: <b>' + expected + '</b>', r.reasoning_len + ' chars'];
      if (r.runner_up) bits.push('runner-up: <b>' + r.runner_up + '</b>');
      meta.innerHTML = bits.map(function (b) { return '<span>' + b + '</span>'; }).join('');
      pre.textContent = r.reasoning || '(no reasoning captured)';
    }

    function renderVerdict(im) {
      var a = im.runs[state.laneA], b = im.runs[state.laneB];
      if (!a || !b) return;
      var summary = document.getElementById('ab-diff-summary');
      var agree = (a.predicted || '') === (b.predicted || '');
      var txt = agree
        ? 'Both runs land on <b>' + (a.predicted || '(no label)') + '</b>' + (a.correct ? ' \u2014 and both are correct.' : ' \u2014 and both miss.')
        : 'Runs <b>disagree</b>: ' + (a.predicted || '(no label)') + ' vs ' + (b.predicted || '(no label)') + '.';
      summary.innerHTML = txt;
    }

    function lineStates(tA, tB) {
      var la = tA.split('\n'), lb = tB.split('\n');
      var max = Math.max(la.length, lb.length);
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < max; i++) {
        var x = la[i] || '', y = lb[i] || '';
        var cls = x === y ? (x ? 'd-same' : 'd-pad') : 'd-diff';
        out.push({ a: x, b: y, cls: cls, i: i });
      }
      return out;
    }

    function applyDiff(laneAEl, laneBEl) {
      var pa = laneAEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-reason');
      var pb = laneBEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-reason');
      var lines = lineStates(pa.textContent || '', pb.textContent || '');
      pa.innerHTML = '';
      pb.innerHTML = '';
      lines.forEach(function (ln) {
        var da = document.createElement('span'); da.className = 'd-line ' + ln.cls; da.textContent = ln.a || '\u00a0';
        var db = document.createElement('span'); db.className = 'd-line ' + ln.cls; db.textContent = ln.b || '\u00a0';
        pa.appendChild(da); pb.appendChild(db);
      });
      var diffs = lines.filter(function (l) { return l.cls === 'd-diff'; }).length;
      var sum = document.getElementById('ab-diff-summary');
      sum.innerHTML = sum.innerHTML + ' \u00b7 <b>' + diffs + '</b> differing line' + (diffs === 1 ? '' : 's');
    }

    function clearDiff() {
      var pa = laneAEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-reason');
      var pb = laneBEl.querySelector('.ab-lane-reason');
      pa.querySelectorAll('.d-line').forEach(function (s) { s.remove(); });
      pb.querySelectorAll('.d-line').forEach(function (s) { s.remove(); });
    }

    // controls
    widgetEl.querySelectorAll('.ab-chip').forEach(function (chip) {
      chip.addEventListener('click', function () {
        widgetEl.querySelectorAll('.ab-chip').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('active'); });
        chip.classList.add('active');
        state.filter = chip.getAttribute('data-filter');
        state.idx = 0;
        render();
      });
    });
    document.getElementById('ab-flips').addEventListener('change', function (e) {
      state.flipsOnly = e.target.checked;
      state.idx = 0;
      render();
    });
    document.getElementById('ab-prev').addEventListener('click', function () {
      state.idx = (state.idx - 1 + Math.max(1, filtered(images).length)) % Math.max(1, filtered(images).length);
      render();
    });
    document.getElementById('ab-next').addEventListener('click', function () {
      state.idx = (state.idx + 1) % Math.max(1, filtered(images).length);
      render();
    });
    laneASel.addEventListener('change', function (e) { state.laneA = parseInt(e.target.value, 10); if (state.laneB === state.laneA) { state.laneB = state.laneA === 0 ? 1 : 0; laneBSel.value = state.laneB; } render(); });
    laneBSel.addEventListener('change', function (e) { state.laneB = parseInt(e.target.value, 10); if (state.laneA === state.laneB) { state.laneA = state.laneB === 0 ? 1 : 0; laneASel.value = state.laneA; } render(); });
    swapBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var t = state.laneA; state.laneA = state.laneB; state.laneB = t;
      laneASel.value = state.laneA; laneBSel.value = state.laneB;
      render();
    });
    diffChk.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
      state.diff = e.target.checked;
      render();
    });

    // default: pick the axis with a flip first
    render();
  }
})();
</script>



All real traces were logged to the Braintrust project; each conversation card shows the source document image
(from the `fixed_size_sampled` slice), the prompt version, and the model that produced the trace.
